scope.source_package_note: Eight bound originals. Seven identical shared source hashes reuse documented earlier complete readings, with current clause/consumer rereads. No GSP-AV supplied. SRL pages24/25/59/60 and ATB9 directly reread. No study cases, expert labels, historical self-tests or manual adaptation test expectations used.

rules.assessment: Coded arable parcels with an eligible known crop and compliant procedure feed the area and payment. Uncoded grassland does not receive a component. Actual complete MFA inputs, area and identity qualification remain necessary; a procedure-code check is not proof that every material legal requirement was actually evidenced. Current missing-evidence and App mappings are assessed in inputs/general/measure parts.

findings.title: Undifferentiated local violation consumption couples code and area admission to management diagnostics
findings.assessment: parcel_code_violations consumes every assigned local parcel violation. code_compliant requires this set to be empty, the primary participation area includes only compliant codes, and that area feeds the minimum and farm access. This single control flow does not explicitly distinguish a source-defined absent/ineligible procedure from an established substantive management obligation breach requiring the source assessment process. Raw assumptions18 and24 disclose area counting and uncomputed sanction assessment. The General part separately documents missing assessed stages/order; this Core finding owns the distinct automatic compliance-to-admission coupling. The physical 2.9ha positive control is correctly deduplicated and remains valid.
findings.impact: The native amount and access components need this boundary when consumed by the App. This is not a claim that every zero amount is unlawful, that every management breach retains eligibility, or that a unique opposite amount or sanction percentage follows. Actual source method nonexistence/admission and assessed substantive sanctions remain separate; no implementation-mirroring assertion or invented full authority payout is introduced.

probes.scenario_boundary: Fresh public hypothetical complete current 2025 Austrian MFA holding. All stated areas, classifications, procedure records, active contractual participations, timely applications and individual requirements are positively known; the farmer is active and actually acts in own name/account. No exit, transfer, takeover, control refusal, revision event, force majeure, trial area, overlapping public support or other deduction occurred. No Vienna humus option. BAW has no other area payment including no BIO basic payment, and no GLÖZ buffer/NPF area; actual GIS path intersection is positively stipulated independently of KG membership. Optional non-events are absent rather than fabricated dates. Result assertions concern the indicated native source-derived component before independent authority assessment; no total legal approval is inferred. The four coded parcels sum to2.9ha. MS+US occurs on the same actual1ha maize parcel and is not counted twice in the farm area. AH uses0.5ha potato, BAW0.4ha with0.1ha path, DS strip-till1ha soy. The uncoded1ha permanent grassland has no measure component. Each procedure is actually performed with all required qualifications and completed records; no ambiguous competing code choice or adverse management event is involved.
